name: HAI: Hardware-in-the-Loop Anomaly Detection Dataset
description: The HAI (Hardware-in-the-Loop Anomaly Detection) dataset was collected on a realistic industrial control system (ICS) testbed by the Cybersecurity and Telecommunications Research Division at Korea Information Security Agency (KISA) and Affiliated Institute of ETRI. The testbed models physical thermal power generation and pump-and-storage hydroelectric plants controlled via GE, Emerson, and Siemens PLCs and DCS. It comprises time-series sensor measurements from 78 to 86 variables (pressures, flows, temperatures, valve positions) sampled every 1 second, with benign operations and 50+ sophisticated cyber-physical injection and manipulation attack scenarios.
